selection_rule: highest non-yanked version without pre-release suffix for each directly used Rust crate; Python pre-release tracked separately
scope: registry and official source research only; QuaZonai dependency files have not been changed; no upgraded engine benchmark or build claimed

fee_money_source_review_2026_10_30.scope: Official 0.67.0 package source inspection and implementation oracle corrections, distinct from historical 0.63 performance observations. Exact Money storage does not change MakerTaker commission rounding. A later lib run confirmed the 0.0008 USD serde assertion passed before the ordinary FromStr assertion failed; final corrected tests and actual CLI precision acceptance require execution on the delivered head.

maker_taker.path: nautilus-execution/src/models/fee.rs MakerTakerFeeModel::get_commission -> nautilus-model/src/fees.rs calculate_maker_taker_commission -> types/money.rs Money::from_decimal -> types/fixed.rs bankers_round
maker_taker.policy: Official per-fill currency-precision half-even rounding; no public MakerTaker option selecting from_decimal_exact/native. Source rates are independent frozen venue policy; actual commission arithmetic stays upstream.

exact_money.path: nautilus-model/src/types/money.rs Money::from_decimal_exact/from_str_exact/as_decimal; Display/Serialize use to_decimal_string; Deserialize calls from_str_exact; ordinary FromStr calls parse(exact=false)
exact_money.policy: Exact construction, explicit exact parsing, Display and serde preserve representable fractional digits below currency precision. Ordinary Money::from_str rounds to currency precision, so parsing the display of exact 0.0008 USD through that trait yields 0.00 USD. Exact roundtrip/accumulation, the ordinary parser's rounding, and commission construction are separate acceptance cases.
exact_money.qz_input_boundary: The six contract-required exact initial-capital/observed-balance inputs use the public Money::from_str_exact API and propagate unrepresentable-value errors. Canonical result Value stays original; account observer projects native as_decimal directly into DecimalValue. The official fee models retain their own rounding policies.

polymarket.policy: Fee-equivalent quantity*rate*price*(1-price); taker ToZero at 5 decimal places; maker negative fee-equivalent*rebate_rate rounded half-even at 5 places; then Money::from_decimal in original quote currency.
polymarket.independent_oracle: Original fixture rate 0.05, price 0.4: each quantity 0.0005 yields zero taker commission; combined quantity 0.001 yields 0.00001. Original source schedule is unchanged; fixture quantities isolate the new rounding boundaries.
